description.en: Coastal hydrochemistry analysis, interpolation step: Generates daily river chemistry time series by filling gaps in observed water-chemistry data.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: List of variable names to process.

variable_units.title: Variable units
variable_units.description: List of variable=unit pairs giving the unit of each variable.

non_mass_vars.title: Non-mass variables
non_mass_vars.description: List of variable names that are not mass concentrations (e.g. pH, temperature) and therefore must not be converted to loads or fluxes.

url_waterchem.title: Water chemistry input
url_waterchem.description: URL of the input water chemistry file.

url_discharge.title: Discharge input
url_discharge.description: URL of the input river discharge file.

river_name.title: River name
river_name.description: Name of the river for which the interpolation is performed.

wc_station_name.title: Water chemistry station name
wc_station_name.description: Name of the water chemistry monitoring station to select from the water chemistry file.

q_station_name.title: Discharge station name
q_station_name.description: Name of the discharge gauging station to select from the discharge file.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the location in decimal degrees (-90 to 90).

longitude.title: Longitude
longitude.description: Longitude of the location in decimal degrees (-180 to 180).

wc_time_col.title: Water chemistry time column
wc_time_col.description: Name of the column containing timestamps in the water chemistry file.

q_time_col.title: Discharge time column
q_time_col.description: Name of the column containing timestamps in the discharge file.

wc_station_col.title: Water chemistry station column
wc_station_col.description: Name of the column containing station names in the water chemistry file.

q_station_col.title: Discharge station column
q_station_col.description: Name of the column containing station names in the discharge file.

discharge_var.title: Discharge variable
discharge_var.description: Name of the column containing the discharge values in the discharge file.

linear_max_gap.title: Maximum gap for linear interpolation
linear_max_gap.description: Maximum gap length (in time steps) that is bridged by linear interpolation. Must be a non-negative integer.

gam_n_splines_q.title: GAM splines for discharge
gam_n_splines_q.description: Number of spline basis functions used for the discharge term of the GAM interpolation model. Must be a positive integer.

gam_n_splines_doy.title: GAM splines for day of year
gam_n_splines_doy.description: Number of spline basis functions used for the seasonal (day-of-year) term of the GAM interpolation model. Must be a positive integer.

validation_repeats.title: Validation repeats
validation_repeats.description: Number of repetitions of the validation procedure. Must be a positive integer.

validation_block_size.title: Validation block size
validation_block_size.description: Size of the blocks of consecutive observations withheld in each validation run. Must be a positive integer.

validation_min_observations.title: Minimum observations for validation
validation_min_observations.description: Minimum number of observations a variable needs for validation to be performed. Must be a non-negative integer.

validation_min_points.title: Minimum validation points
validation_min_points.description: Minimum number of withheld points required for a validation run to be considered valid. Must be a non-negative integer.

validation_min_coverage.title: Minimum validation coverage
validation_min_coverage.description: Minimum fraction (0 to 1) of the data that must be covered by valid validation results.

selection_min_r2.title: Minimum R² for model selection
selection_min_r2.description: Minimum R² (-1 to 1) a candidate interpolation method must reach in validation to be eligible for selection.

selection_r2_tolerance.title: R² tolerance for model selection
selection_r2_tolerance.description: Tolerance on the R² difference within which candidate methods are considered equally good, so that secondary criteria (e.g. simplicity) decide. Must be non-negative.

selection_max_bias_fraction.title: Maximum bias fraction for model selection
selection_max_bias_fraction.description: Maximum allowed bias, expressed as a fraction of the observed mean, for a candidate method to be eligible. Must be non-negative.

selection_extreme_ratio_limit.title: Extreme value ratio limit for model selection
selection_extreme_ratio_limit.description: Maximum allowed ratio between predicted and observed extreme values; methods exceeding it are rejected. Must be non-negative.

interpolation_output.title: Daily modelled water-chemistry NetCDF
interpolation_output.description: Daily chemistry time series with observations preserved and missing values filled using the selected interpolation and fallback methods.
